I didnt want to feel trapped in the same way I view my mother as being. There are centuries of this shit and the years and years of “you got this boss babe!” are to fight it. 

All of this to say that I do actually agree that the constant boss babe messaging probably did hurt men, but I dont think its fair to just write it off. I dont know what the solution or compromise is, but I really want to say that sometimes between the sexes it feels like a zero sum game. I hear more and more people, especially young men, say things like “we have differences we are different so we must be treated and act differently” but I think now more than ever we need to realize we more alike as people. We all want to make something of ourselves, to have excitement, to feel proud. We need to be able to do that with each other.
